[[File:Reward casket (master) detail.png|left|130px]]
A '''[[reward casket]] (master)''' is received after completing the final clue of a [[Clue scroll (master)|master clue scroll]] trail, and contains the final reward for the trail. Opening the reward casket is required for treasure trail completion to be tracked on the [[HiScores]] and [[collection log]].

The player can possess unlimited amounts of reward caskets up to the [[Stackable_items#Limit_of_a_stack|stack limit]]. Players are eligible to receive more clue scrolls regardless of how many reward caskets are in the player's posession.

==Rewards==
Master clues generate a minimum of 5 rewards and a maximum of 7, granting an average of 6 rewards per casket. The rewards consist of generic items, shared treasure trail items, and items that are unique for master clues. Additionally, players have a 1/1,000 chance to receive the [[Bloodhound]] pet upon opening a master casket.

There is also a 1/15 chance of the reward casket being a [[mimic]], which can be taken to the [[strange casket]] in [[Watson]]'s house to fight [[The Mimic]]. Players are only eligible to receive mimics if they have spoken to the strange casket to enable the chance of a reward casket turning into a mimic. If a player attempts to open a master reward casket for the first time before speaking to the strange casket, they will be asked whether they want a chance of a Mimic boss fight or not, and wanting it will result in the chatbox directing players to the strange casket.

All droprates (except for the [[Mimic]] rewards) are confirmed by Mod Tide.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Tide|url=https://twitter.com/JagexTide/status/1131933683714330624|date=24 May 2019|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/106558|archivedate=24 May 2019|quote=I know its been a while since the clue expansion but here is the information on clue scroll drop rates and loot chances! If anything changes I will keep you posted.|name=Clue rates tweet}}{{CiteGeneral|url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/16pVNHdZyynmxIbM9mynRDYT0LQsWxq-vbDs4_7DpnGM/edit?usp=sharing|title=Clue scrolls 2019|author=|time=24 May 2019}} The listed rarities are per roll, except for the Mimic rewards. The average loot roll is worth approximately {{Coins|{{MasterClueValue}}}}.{{efn|This number is lower than it actually is due to multiple 3rd age items trading for above the maximum Grand Exchange price of 2.147 billion.|name=3a}}

On average, it will take 7842 reward caskets to obtain all the unique drops specific to master clues (not including drops shared by other clue tiers). This includes two of the mega-rares (the [[Bucket helm (g)]] and [[Ring of coins]]) since they are unique to the master reward casket, unlike the other mega-rares.

On average, master clues are worth approximately {{Coins|6 * {{MasterClueValue}}}}, if the Mimic fight is not enabled. In comparison, the expected value of the easy through elite clues given to Watson is {{Coins|3*{{EasyClueValue}} + 4*{{MediumClueValue}} + 5*{{HardClueValue}} + 5*{{EliteClueValue}}+(1/5+1/15+1/30+1/50)*6*{{MasterClueValue}}}}, including the value of potential master clues from the caskets themselves.

The Mimic has a significantly boosted chance to reward a piece of 3rd age equipment, adding an expected value of {{Coins|1/15*{{MasterMimicValue}}}} for a total of {{Coins|6 * {{MasterClueValue}} + 1/15*{{MasterMimicValue}}}} per master reward casket. The expected value of the clues given to Watson is {{Coins|3*{{EasyClueValue}} + 4*{{MediumClueValue}} + 5*{{HardClueValue}} + 5*{{EliteClueValue}} + 1/35 * {{EliteMimicValue}} + (1/5+1/15+1/30+1/50)*(6*{{MasterClueValue}} + 1/15*{{MasterMimicValue}}) }}, when additionally including Mimics from the elite casket and potential master clues.

====Mimic rewards====
''Main article: {{Section|The Mimic|Master drops}}''

When enabled, players have a 1/15 chance to find a [[mimic]] casket upon opening their reward casket. Bonus loot is received as an extra reward when opening the mimic casket, in addition to the regular 1-6 clue scroll rolls.

The quantities received depend on how many attempts it took to kill the Mimic. Each failure reduces the quantity by 1/6 of the maximum.

|type = hotfix
|change = The chance of a master reward casket being a mimic was changed from 1/30 to 1/15.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Wolf|url=https://twitter.com/JagexWolf/status/1116299462870274048|date=11 April 2019|archiveurl=https://archive.is/pudqn|archivedate=29 May 2020|quote=We will be changing the rate of the Mimic chance after a discussion with the team and your feedback that it may be a tad too rare. }}

|poll = Old School Content Poll 65: Treasure Trails Expansion
|change = All Treasure Trails caskets were changed to be stackable. To bolster each tier of clue with new cosmetic items, thirteen new items were added as master clue scroll rewards.
}}

==Trivia==
*On release, players could also get rewarded [[Botanical pie|Botanical pies]] from master clues, but this drop was quickly removed after this reward crashed the market of botanical pies.
*In 2016 Mod Mat K revealed in a [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=m-5hXaHEzIM&t=465s data stream] that on average 700 master clue scrolls were completed every day.
*This casket cannot be opened on [[Entrana]], and attempting to do so produces the message {{mes|You cannot open this on Entrana, the monks are watching you too closely.}}
